thread:
pavan: Heads up team  onboarding Vireo-6B (int4). quick smoke shows LRa-like drop on long-context QA and occasional truncation of names. suspect combining-diacritic handling in tokenizer + int4 rotary quantization drift. attaching quick repro.

kai: Can you paste the minimal repro and top metrics?

pavan: run: 
```
./onboard/run_eval --model vireo-6b --dtype int4 --prompts longqa_2k.txt --max-tokens 1024 --batch 6 --seed 11
```
summary (fp16 -> int4):
- EM: 77.0 -> 71.4
- Rouge-L: 41.2 -> 37.0
- p95 latency: 200ms -> 65ms
- failure mode: proper nouns ending in combined diacritics get truncated or dropped after ~300 tokens; also a periodic 1-token echo in some docs.

Example: "José-M. Rivera"
fp16: "José-M. Rivera was appointed..."
int4: "Jos-M. Rivera was appointed..."  (missing combining accent on 'é')

indra: Which tokenizer conversion/normalization path? NFKC/NFKD or preserve? we recently changed the merge window for combining diacritics which can alter token boundaries and shift positions. If boundaries change mid-doc, rotary position->sin/cos lookups will be off and quantized interpolation error can accumulate.

pavan: Used hf-converter v3 with NFKD enabled (default). I dumped token counts around one failing boundary and saw len delta: fp16=14 tokens, converted=13 tokens (merge around U+0301 combining acute).

kai: Pull runtime rotary/meta and quant kernel autosettings. small difference in freq_scale or per-head scaling will amplify position misalignment.

pavan: runtime dump: 
rotary_base=10000; head_dim=64; per_head_scale=true
fp16_kernel: freq_scale=1.0; interp=none
int4_kernel: freq_scale=0.991 (autotune); interp=kbit-linterp

indra: Two quick isolations: 1) re-run int4 forcing freq_scale=1.0 and interp=none to see kernel-only effect; 2) re-convert tokenizer with NFKD disabled/preserve combining marks and re-eval.

pavan: Did both. Forcing freq_scale=1.0 improved EM to 73.8 (partial). Re-converting tokenizer with combining preserved (NFKD off) improved EM to 75.6. Doing both together gives EM 76.8 (nearly closing gap). Token repeats largely gone.

kai: Sounds like a mixed root cause: tokenizer changed token boundaries + int4 autotune chose a slightly shrunk freq_scale and a lerp interp that introduces tiny phase error. Action items:
- pavan: open PR documenting the tokenizer caveat and include 50 failing examples in /shared/onboard/vireo/diacritics. Add a converter flag to preserve combining marks by default for onboarding.
- indra: add a small CI token-count check that tokenizes 200 canonical long sentences with both converter settings and fails if any sequence length differs. Also add a runtime canary flag to pin freq_scale/interp for quant kernels.
- kai: if residual gaps remain after PR, run a per-head rotary requant calibration on a stratified long-doc corpus (5k steps).

ci-bot: ci:tokenizer-preserve-check -> job queued: vireo-diacritic-counts (200 docs).

pavan: I'll open PR and upload diffs. Thanks for the quick triage. :thumbsup:
